products.currentTitle: Wall Repair Roller Paint -White Wall Repair Painting Solution
products.title: Wall Repair Roller Paint – 2-in-1 Touch-Up Roller (White)
products.seoTitle: Wall Repair Roller Paint – White Touch-Up Roller
products.seoDescription: Cover small marks, scuffs and patches on white walls with a 2-in-1 roller and paint bottle. No tray, no open paint tin. Shop at The Ghar Store.
description: Small marks on a white wall don’t need a full repaint. This touch-up roller keeps the paint and the roller together: squeeze the bottle, and paint flows to a small foam roller you can run straight over the mark.

It’s made for quick fixes — crayon lines, scuff marks near switches, small patches after removing a nail or hook — on walls that are already white. Because there’s no tray or open tin, it’s easy to do a two-minute fix and put it away.
The roller head comes off for rinsing, so you can use the same bottle again for the next touch-up.
specifications: Small marks and patches on white interior walls
howToUse: Wipe the area with a dry cloth so it’s free of dust and grease. Let it dry fully.
Hold the bottle upright and squeeze gently until the roller is evenly wet. Roll it on a piece of paper first to spread the paint.
Roll back and forth over the mark with light pressure. Thin coats look better than one thick coat.
Let the first coat dry completely (follow the drying time on the bottle) and add a second coat if the mark still shows.
Pull off the roller, rinse it under running water, let it dry and close the cap tightly.
products.care: Close the cap tightly after every use so the paint doesn’t dry in the nozzle. Rinse the roller with water while the paint is still wet. Store upright, away from direct sun and out of reach of children.
faqs: Will it match my wall colour?
Only if your wall is white. The paint is white, so on coloured or off-white walls the patch may show. Try it on a small hidden spot first.
Can it fill deep cracks or holes?
It’s for surface marks and small patches. Deep cracks or holes need wall putty or filler first; you can use this roller to paint over the dried filler.
How many coats will I need?
Light marks usually need one or two thin coats. Dark marks such as pen or crayon may need more. Let each coat dry before the next.
Can I use it again later?
Yes. Rinse the roller after use and close the cap tightly. Paint that’s left open will dry out.
Does it smell strongly?
Paints of this kind usually have a mild smell. Keep the room airy while it dries.

products.currentTitle: Magic Broom Sweeper for Floor Cleaning (Pack of 1)
products.title: Magic Floor Wiper with Rotating Head
products.seoTitle: Magic Floor Wiper with Rotating Head & Steel Pole
products.seoDescription: A floor wiper with a soft rubber blade, 180° rotating head and steel pole. Push water, dust and hair off tiles and marble in a few strokes.
description: After you mop the floor or wash the bathroom, this wiper pushes the water away in long, clean strokes. The soft rubber blade sits flat on the floor, so it gathers water, hair and loose dust without scratching tiles or marble.

The head turns, which makes it easy to reach under the sofa, along walls and into corners. The steel pole is long enough to work standing up, and the loop at the top lets you hang it on a hook when you’re done.
specifications: Tiles, marble, kota and other smooth hard floors; bathroom and balcony floors
howToUse: Fit the pole into the head (if packed separately) and set the height that’s comfortable for you.
Turn the head to the angle you need — flat for open floor, angled for corners and under furniture.
Push water or dust in long strokes towards the drain, door or a dustpan. Lift the blade between strokes for a cleaner finish.
Rinse the blade, shake off the water and hang the wiper by its loop to dry.
products.care: Rinse the rubber blade after use and let it dry. Hang it up rather than leaving it standing on the blade, so the edge stays straight. Keep it away from sharp objects that could nick the rubber.
faqs: Does it work on dry floors?
Yes, it can push loose hair, crumbs and dust into a pile. For fine dust on large areas a broom or vacuum may still be quicker.
Is it safe for marble and wooden floors?
The blade is soft rubber, which is gentle on smooth hard floors like marble and tiles. On wooden floors, avoid leaving standing water.
Can I use it on glass?
You can use the blade on large glass doors or windows. Use light pressure and a clean blade.
Is it a broom?
No — it’s a rubber-blade wiper (squeegee). It works best for pushing water and loose debris, not for sweeping rough surfaces.

Will the colours fade?
Keep it out of strong direct sunlight and wash gently to keep the colours bright.

products.seoTitle: Rechargeable Cordless Screwdriver Kit with Bits & Case
products.seoDescription: A rechargeable screwdriver with a folding handle, bits and a carry case — for curtain rods, furniture assembly and small fixes at home.
description: Curtain rods, wall shelves, flat-pack furniture, loose cupboard hinges — this rechargeable screwdriver handles the small jobs that come up every month at home.

The handle folds: keep it straight for tight spaces, or turn it into a pistol grip for more control. Everything — bits, sockets and the charging cable — packs into one hard case, so nothing goes missing.
specifications: Folds between straight and pistol grip
Assorted bits, sockets and extension (count to be confirmed)
howToUse: Charge the screwdriver with the cable before first use.
Push the right bit firmly into the chuck.
Use the switch to set forward (tighten) or reverse (loosen).
Hold the screwdriver straight in line with the screw and press the trigger. Finish the last turn gently so you don’t strip the screw head.
products.care: Store in its case in a dry place. Recharge every few months if not in use. Don’t use it as a drill on concrete or metal. Keep away from water and children.
faqs: Can it drill holes in walls?
No. It’s a screwdriver for driving and removing screws. For concrete or brick walls you need a drill machine.
How long does a charge last?
It depends on the job. We’re confirming the battery details with our supplier and will add them here.
Can I use it manually if the battery runs out?
Many screwdrivers of this type can be turned by hand for a final tightening. We’ll confirm for this model.

products.title: Bendable Microfiber Fan Duster
products.seoDescription: Dust ceiling fan blades more easily. A soft microfiber duster head that bends to wrap around each blade.
description: Dusting ceiling fans is one of those jobs everyone puts off. This duster has a soft, chenille-style microfiber head that bends to wrap around the blade, so it catches dust from the top and bottom in one pass.
Use it on fan blades, top of cupboards, AC vents and other high places that are hard to reach.
howToUse: Make sure the fan has fully stopped.
Bend the duster head into a curve that fits over the blade.
Hook it over the blade and pull it gently towards you.
Shake the head outdoors or over a bin.
products.care: Shake out after each use. If the head is removable, wash it in mild soapy water and let it air dry before the next use.
faqs: Do I need a ladder?
For most homes with standard ceiling height you can reach the fan standing on the floor. We’re confirming the exact handle length.
Can I use it wet?
Use it dry for dust. For sticky grime, wipe the blades with a damp cloth afterwards.

Can children use it?

products.seoDescription: LED diyas that glow when you pour in water. No oil, no flame, no smoke. Pack of 12.
description: Pour a little water in and the diya lights up — no oil, no matchstick, no smoke. Pour it out and the light goes off.

Because there’s no open flame, they’re easy to place near curtains, on shelves and around rangoli, and safer around children and pets. Their red terracotta-style colour keeps the traditional diya look.
specifications: Lights up when water is added
Built-in (type and replaceability to be confirmed)
howToUse: Set the diya on a flat surface.
Pour clean water into the diya up to the marked level. It lights up.
Pour the water out to turn it off. Wipe it dry before storing.
products.care: Use clean water only. Empty and dry each diya after use and store in a dry box — leaving water inside can shorten battery life. Don’t submerge the diya.
faqs: Do I need oil or a wick?
No. Only water. There is no flame.
How long does the battery last?
We’re confirming battery details with our supplier. Emptying the water when not in use saves the battery.
Can I use them outdoors?
Yes, on a covered balcony or entrance. Keep them out of heavy rain.
Are they safe for kids?
There’s no flame or heat, which makes them a safer choice. They contain small batteries — keep them away from very young children.

Does it work in the bathroom?

Will it damage my wall?
On tiles and glass it usually peels off cleanly. On painted walls, removal can lift paint.

products.title: Colourful Reflection Diyas with Wick Holders – Pack of 10
products.seoTitle: Colourful Reflection Diyas (Pack of 10) with Wick Holders
products.seoDescription: Flower-shaped coloured diyas that throw a glowing pattern around the flame. Use with oil and wick. Pack of 10.
description: These flower-shaped diyas are made of tinted, see-through material, so when the wick is lit the colour glows and spreads a pattern of light around each diya.
They use oil and a wick like a traditional diya — with a small metal holder that keeps the wick upright in the centre.
howToUse: Push a cotton wick through the metal holder.
Place the holder in the centre of the diya and check the metal tube stands straight.
Pour about one spoon of water first, then oil on top. The water layer keeps the base cooler.
Light the wick and place the diya on a stable, heat-safe surface.
products.care: Let diyas cool completely before touching or moving them. Wipe off oil with a soft cloth and warm soapy water. Store in the box so they don’t scratch.
products.safety: This is an open flame. Never leave a lit diya unattended. Keep it away from curtains, paper and rangoli powder, and out of reach of children and pets. Always add water before oil.
faqs: Are these LED?
No — they use oil and a wick, like a traditional diya. If you want flame-free diyas, see our water-sensor LED diyas.
Why add water?
A spoon of water under the oil keeps the base cooler and helps the diya last longer.
Can I reuse them?
Yes. Clean them after they cool and replace the wick next time.

faqs: Can I use it on tiles or marble?

Every few weeks for furniture you use daily, or whenever the wood looks dull.

It can make light surface scratches less visible. Deep scratches need a wood filler or touch-up.
